all_variants: six pure imputation ablations plus raw control and fixed linear25+control, no post-result method selection
bridge: ball only, bounded holes with two observed anchors each side in one contiguous period, speed/acceleration/uncertainty gates fixed in grid; no player or long-gap reconstruction
compute: CPU only; preprocessing, four control fits, inference and evaluation charged to phase ledger
control_fit: matched C0 V1 observations and deterministic known-row sampler; add one local-arrival feature to the visible head only; no imputed training labels or positions
control_interpretation: bounded potential at current ball location from minimum anonymous arrival times, not a whole-pitch control model or observed possession
feature_rounding: original builder physical columns cast float32 before named team design; all non-updated score rows bit-identical to C0
freeze: all 22 nine-way predictions per outer holdout hashed before opening its targets for scoring; synthetic position accuracy evaluated afterwards
kalman: constant-velocity two-state-per-axis Gaussian filter, observed left position and adjacent velocity, right position and next position updates; RTS backwards smoother; raw endpoints never overwritten
position_accuracy: native DFL ball coordinates removed by the stress generator, audit mask used only for evaluation, never features; report RMSE/p90/2-sigma coverage and filled fraction by duration
reference: reuse and hash-check the exact J9 C0-OOF three-match fits, priors and predictions; no J9 variant promoted
score_update: only supported H/A conditional probabilities change; D probabilities and state support bit-identical to C0; imputed team source code 4, raw observation mask remains separate
scoring: same 22 V2 conditions, S41 and R4/gates from J8; official spellF1, macroF1, D, boundaries, fragmentation, recall under 1/2/5 seconds
selection: internal screen only; C0 remains delivery pending J18/J19
training: only four original training matches in outer leave-one-match-out folds; no confirmation, J03WR9 or competition labels
uncertainty: engineering proxy in metres, lower bound from measurement/acceleration bridge proxy; not learned or statistically calibrated
